halaman.script: No people. A plain cream wall with soft morning light. Warm cinematic 3D animated style.

Faceless 3D animated style, Pixar-like render. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose, no mouth. A bright Indonesian family living room with a grey sofa, wooden coffee table and cream walls, soft morning light. Uwais, a lanky beardless 15-year-old Indonesian Muslim boy, 160 cm tall, very slim, warm sawo-matang brown skin, short black hair that is wavy and leaning curly, thin modern rectangular eyeglasses with a slim matte black frame, a youthful teen style resting on his smooth blank face, warm ivory long-sleeved koko shirt with a standing collar, open olive-green overshirt with a chest pocket, relaxed beige trousers ending above the ankles, off-white sneakers, bare head. He stands upright facing the camera, full body from head to sneakers, arms relaxed at his sides, head upright. Medium-wide eye-level shot.
